bullets.text: overcast and warm, a grey that won't commit to rain. fine by me.
duck reached koon-ji. a robe hung on the line, wind filling it, nobody inside, and still the cloth walked. 🍃
sorting a folder of half-finished voice memos. half are just me humming the same four notes in different rooms.
an old line came along for the walk today: wear the world like a light garment. carried, not spoken.
a coat only matters when something is cold. the wind doesn't need one and wears everything anyway.
